cards.name: Melisandre
cards.text: Shadow (5). Stealth. Each participating character without shadow gets -1 STR. Challenges Action: Choose a character with STR 1 or lower and place it in shadows. (Limit once per phase.)

cards.name: Edric Storm
cards.text:
Stealth.
Each player cannot gain more than 3 power each round (among all cards they control).
cards.flavor: “And may the Father judge you justly, Lord Davos.”

cards.name: Ser Clayton Suggs
cards.text: Reaction: After power is gained by or moved to a character, that character gets +1 STR or -1 STR until the end of the phase. (Limit 3 times per phase.)
cards.flavor: "What sort of god lets himself be pissed upon by dogs?"

cards.name: Stormlord
cards.text: Renown. Forced Reaction: After the dominance phase begins, if you control no King characters, sacrifice a character.
cards.flavor: “Most of the lords who rode with Lord Renly to Storm's End have gone over banner-and-blade to Stannis, with all their chivalry.” - Varys

cards.name: Red Keep Servant
cards.text: While you control a King's Landing location, Red Keep Servant gains an [intrigue] icon and cannot be bypassed by stealth.
cards.flavor: "It was well known that in the Red Keep the very walls have ears." <cite>The Queen of Thorns</cite>

cards.name: Living Shadow
cards.text: No attachments. Shadow (1). Stealth. Living Shadow cannot be killed. Forced Reaction: After Living Shadow bypasses a character using stealth, attach it to that character as a Condition attachment with the text: "Terminal. Attached character cannot be saved."

cards.name: The King's Justice
cards.text: Unique character only. Reaction: After you win a [power] challenge, kneel attached character to choose and kill a kneeling character controlled by the losing opponent.
cards.flavor: "If the wicked do not fear the King's Justice, you have put the wrong man in the office." <cite>Cersei Lannister</cite>

cards.name: Roast Boar
cards.text: Opponent's character only. Attached character's controller may choose not to stand attached character during the standing phase. Reaction: After attached character stands, sacrifice Roast Boar to draw 3 cards.
cards.flavor: "They cooked it with mushrooms and apples, and it tasted like triumph." <cite>Cersei Lannister </cite>

cards.name: Narrow Sea Dromond
cards.text: Shadow (1). Narrow Sea Dromond contributes 1 STR to your total for dominance. Reaction: After Narrow Sea Dromond comes out of shadows, choose and kneel a character with printed cost 4 or lower.

cards.name: Northern Pyre
cards.text: Challenges Action: If there is a Winter plot card revealed, kneel Northern Pyre to choose a participating character. Until the end of the challenge, set that character's STR to 3.
cards.flavor: The heat of the flames beat against her face, but even so she shivered.

cards.name: A New Hand
cards.text: Reaction: After a Small Council character you control leaves play, search your deck for a different Small Council character, reveal it, and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. (Max 1 per phase.)
cards.flavor: “Lord Eddard Stark, I would name you the Hand of the King”- Robert Baratheon

cards.name: No Crown but Truth
cards.text: Interrupt: When the effects of an opponent's triggered character ability would initiate, kill a Maester character to cancel those effects and draw 1 card.
cards.flavor: "A clever fool and a foolish wise man. A crown to match your chain, Lord Maester." <cite>Melisandre</cite>

cards.name: Ralf the Limper
cards.text: Pillage. Shadow (5). Reaction: After a non-character card is discarded from an opponent's deck, choose a card you control with shadow and return it to shadows. (Limit twice per round.)

cards.name: Theon Greyjoy
cards.text: Forced Reaction: After a player collects income, they must choose and kill a character they control. Forced Interrupt: When Theon Greyjoy leaves play, each opponent gains 2 power for their faction.
cards.designer: Card design by 2012 European Joust Champion, Stefano Montanari.

cards.name: Moqorro
cards.text: Shadow (2). Reaction: After Moqorro comes out of shadows, choose a character. Until the end of the phase, that character gains an [intrigue] icon and stealth.
cards.flavor: "Every night in my fires I glimpse the glory that awaits you."

cards.name: Orkmont Elite
cards.text: Assault. Pillage. While Orkmont Elite has an attachment, it gains renown. Reaction: After Orkmont Elite discards a card using pillage, put an attachment from the losing opponent's discard pile into play under your control, attached to a character you control.

cards.name: Shipborn Bastard
cards.text:
X is the number of cards you control with initiative modifiers. 
+1 Initiative.

cards.name: Wandering Disciple
cards.text: Shadow (3). Reaction: After Wandering Disciple comes out of shadows, put a non-unique Drowned God character into play from your dead pile. At the end of the phase, if that card is still in play, discard it from play.

cards.name: Smiler
cards.text: Ambush (2). Reaction: After you win an unopposed challenge in which attached character is attacking, kneel Smiler to have attached character gain intimidate or renown until the end of the challenge.

cards.name: Reaver's Greataxe
cards.text: Non-unique [greyjoy] character only. Attached character gains the Raider trait. During the first challenge you initiate each phase, attached character does not kneel when declared as an attacker against an opponent who controls fewer attachments than you.

cards.name: Lonely Light
cards.text:
While Lonely Light is standing, increase the cost for each player to bring cards out of shadows by 1.
+1 Reserve.

cards.name: Swift Longship
cards.text: Shadow (0). Reaction: After Swift Longship comes out of shadows during a challenge, choose a defending character with printed STR 4 or lower. That character does not contribute its STR to this challenge. +1 Initiative.

cards.name: Naval Bombardment
cards.text: Challenges Action: Choose an opponent who controls fewer locations than you. Until the end of the phase, that player cannot initiate [intrigue] challenges against you.
cards.flavor: "None is to leave save at my command, neither man nor crow.” - Victarion Greyjoy

cards.name: Taking the Shield Islands
cards.text: Shadow (1). Reaction: After you win a challenge in which you control an attacking Raider character, look at the losing opponent's hand. Then, choose 1 card in that hand and place it on top of its owner's deck. (Choose up to 2 cards and place them in any order instead if you played this event from shadows.) (Max 1 per challenge.)

cards.name: Crawn Son of Calor
cards.text:
Shadow (4). Stealth.
You may marshal Crawn Son of Calor into shadows from your discard pile as if he were in your hand.
cards.flavor: Tyrion was not amused. Crawn would be even less so; his Moon Brothers had the guard today.

cards.name: Ser Osfryd Kettleblack
cards.text: While you have more cards in hand than each opponent, Ser Osfryd Kettleblack gains renown.
cards.flavor: "We'll have them all before the sun comes up, Your Grace.''

cards.name: Gyles Rosby
cards.text:
If you have no gold in your gold pool during the challenges phase, kill Gyles Rosby.
+2 Income.
cards.flavor: “No doubt he will cough the whole lot of us into our graves.” -  Cersei Lannister

cards.name: Ashemark Councilor
cards.text: X is the number of cards with 1 or more gold. Reaction: After Ashemark Councilor enters play, choose up to 3 cards without gold. Each of those cards gains 1 gold.

cards.name: The Imp's Agent
cards.text: Shadow (3). Reaction: After you win a challenge in which The Imp's Agent is participating, return it to shadows to have the losing opponent choose a card in their hand and place it on the top or bottom of their deck.

cards.name: Alchemist Apprentice
cards.text: Dominance Action: Kneel Alchemist Apprentice to choose a non-limited location with printed cost 2 or lower and return it to its owner's hand. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: The pyromancer looked indecently pleased with that prospect.

cards.name: Joffrey's Crossbow
cards.text:
If attached character is Joffrey Baratheon, he gains intimidate.
While attached character is attacking, unique characters must be chosen for [military] claim, if able.
cards.flavor: "The king is playing with his new crossbow" <cite>Tyrion Lannister</cite>

cards.name: Slander and Lies
cards.text: Opponent's character only. Ambush (3). Terminal. You may spend each power on attached character as if it were 2 gold in your gold pool. Forced Reaction: After you lose a challenge in which attached character is participating, it gains 1 power.

cards.name: Lannisport
cards.text: Reaction: After a [power] challenge is initiated against you, kneel Lannisport to end the challenge with no winner or loser unless the attacking player chooses and discards 1 card from their hand. +1 Income.

cards.name: King's Landing Dromond
cards.text: Shadow (1). Reduce the number of unspent gold you return to the treasury during the taxation phase by 1. Reaction: After King's Landing Dromond comes out of shadows, choose a character with printed cost 2 or lower and return it to its owner's hand.

cards.name: All the Gold in Casterly Rock
cards.text: Limited. Shadow (0). Reaction: After you win an [intrigue] challenge, gain 2 gold for each card you control in shadows.
cards.flavor:
“The gold I grant you, but the Rock is mine.”
- Tyrion Lannister

cards.name: The Regent's Council
cards.text: Reaction: After you win an [intrigue] challenge in which you control a participating Small Council character or Cersei Lannister, determine dominance. (Max 1 per phase.)
cards.flavor: Cersei had uprooted every rose, and all those beholden to her uncle and her brothers. In their places were men whose loyalty would be to her.

cards.name: The Red Viper
cards.text: Shadow (5). Stealth. Action: During a challenge in which The Red Viper is attacking, discard 1 card from shadows to raise the claim value on your revealed plot card by 1 until the end of the challenge. (Limit once per challenge.)
cards.flavor: "I am going to kill that."

cards.name: Ser Manfrey Martell
cards.text:
Renown.
While Ser Manfrey Martell is participating in a challenge, insight and renown resolve for the losing player instead of the winning player.

cards.name: Ser Gulian Qorgyle
cards.text: Reaction: After a character an opponent controls is declared as an attacker or defender, it loses a challenge icon of your choice until the end of the phase. (Limit twice per phase.)
cards.flavor: "They're scorpions, ser. House Qorgyle of Sandstone, three scorpions black on red." <cite>Podrick Payne</cite>

cards.name: Ghost Hill Elite
cards.text: Ambush (6). No attachments. Reaction: After Ghost Hill Elite enters play, choose a character. Until the end of the phase, that character loses an [intrigue] or [power] icon and Ghost Hill Elite gains that icon. Then, if that character has no challenge icons, kill it.

cards.name: Maester of the Tor
cards.text: Shadow (2). Reaction: After Maester of the Tor comes out of shadows, place the top card of your deck in shadows.

cards.name: Southron Informant
cards.text: Ambush (1). Forced Reaction: After Southron Informant enters play during the challenges phase, give control of it to an opponent. Then, discard 1 card at random from that player's hand and draw 1 card.

cards.name: The Viper's Spear
cards.text: Sand Snake character or The Red Viper only. During [military] challenges, attached character gets +3 STR and does not kneel when declared as an attacker against an opponent who controls more characters than you.

cards.name: Hidden in Shadow
cards.text: Character you control only. Shadow (0). Action: Sacrifice Hidden in Shadow to place attached character in shadows. Reaction: After Hidden in Shadow is discarded from shadows, draw 1 card.
cards.designer: Card design by 2018 Joust World Champion, Lennart Paga.

cards.name: Yronwood
cards.text: Interrupt: When the effects of an opponent's reaction to winning a challenge would initiate, kneel Yronwood to cancel those effects.

cards.name: Dornish Sloop
cards.text: Shadow (0). Reaction: After Dornish Sloop comes out of shadows, choose a character with printed cost 5 or lower. Until the end of the phase, that character loses a challenge icon of your choice. +1 Reserve.

cards.name: A Toast to the King
cards.text: Play only if you control a [martell] Lord or Lady character. Interrupt: When the challenges phase ends, choose an opponent and a challenge type. If that player does not control a character with a challenge icon of that type, they must satisfy the claim of that challenge type as if you were the winning opponent. (Max 1 per phase.)

cards.name: Retribution
cards.text: Reaction: After a character you control is killed for [military] claim, if you control fewer characters than the attacking player, that player must choose and kill an attacking character.
cards.flavor: "Only royal blood can wash out my father's murder." <cite>Nymeria Sand</cite>

cards.name: Benjen Stark
cards.text: Renown. Reaction: After you win a [military] challenge in which Benjen Stark is attacking, name a challenge type. Until the end of the phase, the losing opponent cannot initiate challenges of that type against you.
cards.flavor: "Our wife is duty. Our mistress is honor."

cards.name: Dirk
cards.text: Forced Reaction: After a character is discarded from play, place it in its owner's dead pile.
cards.flavor: “There are no laws beyond the Wall, old man. Remember?”

cards.name: Wick Whittlestick
cards.text: Shadow (3). Reaction: After Wick Whittlestick comes out of shadows during a challenge in which you control a participating character, each player must choose a participating character they control, if able, and discard it from play.

cards.name: Northern Envoy
cards.text: Reaction: After Northern Envoy enters play, reveal the top 10 cards of an opponent's deck. Choose 1 non-unique character revealed this way and place it in that player's discard pile. Shuffle that player's deck.

cards.name: Greyguard Artisan
cards.text: Shadow (2). Reaction: After Greyguard Artisan comes out of shadows, choose an attachment. Until the end of the phase, treat that attachment as if its printed text box were blank (except for Traits).

cards.name: Oathsworn Wildling
cards.text: If you do not control another Wildling character or Jon Snow, sacrifice Oathsworn Wildling.
cards.flavor: “Tormund has given me his oath. He will serve with us until the spring.” - Jon Snow

cards.name: Conspirator's Blade
cards.text: Shadow (1). While attached character is participating in a challenge, the effects of events you play cannot be canceled. Reaction: After Conspirator's Blade comes out of shadows, reduce the cost of the next card you bring out of shadows this phase by 2.

cards.name: Torch and Oil
cards.text: Reaction: After an opponent draws a card or marshals a card into shadows, kneel Torch and Oil to reveal that card. If it is a character, you may sacrifice Torch and Oil to discard that card and stand attached character.
cards.flavor: Up above another fire was blooming. The old wooden steps had drunk up oil like a sponge.

cards.name: The Black Gate
cards.text: Action: Kneel The Black Gate and sacrifice a [thenightswatch] character to put a character with equal or lower printed cost that shares a Trait with that character into play from your hand or shadows area.

cards.name: Grey Galley
cards.text:
Shadow (1).
Grey Galley contributes 1 STR to your side during any challenge in which you control a defending character. (3 STR instead if Grey Galley came out of shadows this phase.)

cards.name: Seventy-Nine Sentinels
cards.text: Challenges Action: During a challenge in which you control a defending [thenightswatch] character, kneel any number of [thenightswatch] characters with 1 or fewer challenge icons to have them participate in the challenge on your side.
cards.flavor: "They left their posts in life, so in death their watch goes on forever" <cite>Bran Stark</cite>

cards.name: When All Is Darkest
cards.text: Shadow (2). Reaction: After a character comes out of shadows, kneel your faction card to take control of that character.
cards.flavor: "If the Wall falls, night falls as well, the long night that never ends." <cite>Melisandre</cite>

cards.name: Tytos Blackwood
cards.text: Renown. While Tytos Blackwood is participating in a challenge, treat each other character without power as if its printed text box were blank (except for Traits).

cards.name: Howland Reed
cards.text:
Stealth.
Reduce the cost of the first [stark] card you bring out of shadows each round by 2.
cards.flavor: “But they will not fail. My father knew the worth of Howland Reed.” - Robb Stark

cards.name: Steelshanks Walton
cards.text: Dominance Action: Choose a non-loyal character you own and take control of it. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.flavor: "Steelshanks, he is called. A soldier of iron loyalty." <cite>Roose Bolton</cite>

cards.name: House Umber Berserkers
cards.text:
Assault. No attachments. Shadow (X).
X is the number of plot cards in your used pile (minimum of 1).
cards.flavor: “The Umbers may seem simple, but they are not without a certain low cunning” - Roose Bolton

cards.name: Northern Patriarch
cards.text: Immune to opponents' Omen plot effects. Interrupt: When the effects of an opponent's event would initiate, cancel those effects unless that player moves 1 power from a card they control to Northern Patriarch. (Max once per round.)
cards.designer:
Card design by 2012 World Champion, Derek Shoemaker.
In Memory of Guy Gray.

cards.name: Trident Guard
cards.text: While your claim value is higher than an opponent's, Trident Guard gains renown.
cards.flavor: "They shall not cross." <cite>Ser Edmure Tully</cite>

cards.name: The Warden of the North
cards.text: [stark] Lord character only. Attached character gains the Commander trait and renown. While attached character is participating in a challenge, each player cannot play events or bring cards out of shadows.

cards.name: Dubious Loyalties
cards.text: Non-loyal character you own only. Attached character gains the House Bolton trait, stealth, and renown. Reaction: After you win a challenge by 5 or more STR, discard the top card of your deck to take control of attached character. (Any player may initiate this ability.)

cards.name: Winterfell Kennels
cards.text: Each Direwolf character you control gets +1 STR. Challenges Action: Kneel Winterfell Kennels to put a Direwolf card into play from your hand. At the end of the phase, if that card is still in play, place it on the bottom of your deck.
cards.designer: Card design by 2023 Stahleck Melee Champion, David Kennedy.

cards.name: White Harbor Galley
cards.text: Shadow (1). While you are the attacking or defending player, each participating character gets +1 STR. Reaction: After White Harbor Galley comes out of shadows during a challenge in which you control a participating character, kneel a character you control to have it participate in the challenge on your side.

cards.name: Above the Rest
cards.text: Reaction: After a character you control gains exactly 1 power, have it gain 1 power. Then, if that character has the House Tully trait, stand it. (Max 1 per phase.)
cards.flavor: Lord Jason Mallister had brought his power out from Seagard to join them as they swept around the headwaters of the Blue Fork.

cards.name: "Wolves in the Hills"
cards.text: Interrupt: When claim is applied for a challenge, return an attacking Direwolf character or an attacking character with a Direwolf attachment to your hand to apply claim of another challenge type instead.

cards.name: Magister Illyrio
cards.text: Insight. Shadow (5). Reaction: After the challenges phase begins, gain 1 gold for every 2 cards in shadows. +1 Income.

cards.name: Ser Harry Strickland
cards.text: Renown. Shadow (3). Reaction: After Ser Harry Strickland enters play, choose and stand a Mercenary character. Until the end of the phase, that character gains a challenge icon of your choice.
cards.flavor: Homeless Harry looked little like a warrior.

cards.name: Red Lamb
cards.text: While you control Ser Barristan Selmy, Red Lamb gains a [power] icon and the Knight trait.
cards.flavor: "Why did you make your people lambs, when the world is full of wolves?"

cards.name: War Elephants
cards.text: Ambush (8). Intimidate. No attachments. Reduce the cost to ambush War Elephants by 1 for each Commander character you control. War Elephants cannot be marshaled or placed during setup.

cards.name: Sorrowful Man
cards.text: Shadow (2). Reaction: After Sorrowful Man comes out of shadows, switch a character in an opponent's discard pile with a character in that player's dead pile.
cards.flavor: "I am so sorry."

cards.name: White Graces
cards.text: Interrupt: When White Graces is discarded from your hand or deck, place it on a unique Lady or Grace character as a duplicate instead of placing it in your discard pile.
cards.flavor: They made for a pretty portrait, the proud old woman all in green surrounded by the little girls robed and veiled in white, armored in their innocence.

cards.name: Queen of Meereen
cards.text: Lady character only. Attached character gains the Queen trait. Action: Kneel Queen of Meereen to discard 1 or more cards from your hand. Reduce the cost of the next card you marshal, ambush, or bring out of shadows this phase by 2 for each card discarded this way.

cards.name: Poisoned Locusts
cards.text:
Opponent's character only. Shadow (0). Terminal.
While attached character is participating in a challenge, it gets -1 STR for each attachment it has and is killed if its STR is 0.
cards.flavor: “You ought to try a few yourself, my love.”- Hizdahr zo Loraq

cards.name: Slaver's Bay
cards.text:
Each participating character is killed if its STR is 0 during:
- [military] challenges, if you control Astapor.
- [intrigue] challenges, if you control Yunkai.
- [power] challenges, if you control Meereen.

cards.name: Qartheen Galleas
cards.text: Shadow (1). You are considered to have 1 fewer card in your hand. Reaction: After Qartheen Galleas comes out of shadows, choose a card with shadow in your discard pile and return it to your hand.

cards.name: Take to the Sky!
cards.text: Play only if you control a Dragon character. Interrupt: When a Dragon or Stormborn character would be killed or discarded from play, save it and return it to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor: She had the whip in her hand and she was shouting, then she was on the dragon's back, flying.

cards.name: The Stallion Who Mounts the World
cards.text: Reaction: After you win a [power] challenge as the attacking player, kneel your faction card to search your deck for a Dothraki character and put it into play. Shuffle your deck. The defending player may kill 2 characters to cancel this effect.

cards.name: Baelor Brightsmile
cards.text: Renown. Reaction: After you win a challenge by 5 or more STR in which Baelor Brightsmile is participating, reveal the top card of your deck. You may place that card on Baelor Brightsmile facedown as a duplicate.

cards.name: Megga Tyrell
cards.text: Reaction: After 1 or more characters are removed from a challenge, gain 1 power for your faction. (Limit twice per round.)
cards.flavor: “Someday I want some champion to wear my favor, and kill a hundred men.”

cards.name: Butterbumps
cards.text: Shadow (2). Challenges Action: During a challenge in which Butterbumps is participating, return him to shadows to choose a participating character with a higher STR than his. Stand that character and remove it from the challenge.

cards.name: Horn Hill Vanguard
cards.text:
Assault. Intimidate. No attachments.
While Horn Hill Vanguard is attacking, it gets +1 STR for each standing [tyrell] character you control.
cards.flavor: "It takes more than a pretty cloak to charge a shield wall." <cite>Randyll Tarly</cite>

cards.name: Undercity Spymaster
cards.text: Shadow (3). Stealth.
cards.flavor: Men spoke of seeing him down in the undercity, in rat pits and black brothels, consorting with mummers, singers, sellswords, even beggars.

cards.name: Agent of the Citadel
cards.text: Reaction: After you win a challenge in which Agent of the Citadel is participating, reveal the top card of your deck to reduce the cost of the next card you bring out of shadows this phase by 2.

cards.name: Enameled Green Armor
cards.text: Character you control only. Attached character gains renown. Challenges Action: During a challenge in which attached character is participating, kneel Enameled Green Armor to choose a participating character. That character contributes its STR to your side this challenge.

cards.name: Highgarden Destrier
cards.text:
Limit 1 copy per character. Character with printed STR 3 or lower only. 
Attached character gets +1 STR for each character you control with printed cost 3 or lower.
cards.flavor: Destriers were trained to kick and bite. In war they were a weapon, like the men who rode them.

cards.name: The Whispering Sound
cards.text: Shadow (1). Reaction: After a location enters play during the challenges phase, kneel The Whispering Sound to draw 2 cards. Then, choose a card in your hand and place it on top of your deck.

cards.name: Redwyne Merchanter
cards.text: Shadow (1). Reaction: After Redwyne Merchanter comes out of shadows, choose a character. Until the end of the phase, that character gets +2 STR. +1 Income

cards.name: Beneath the Petals
cards.text: Shadow (0). Action: Choose a character with shadow. Until the end of the phase, that character gains insight and a challenge icon of your choice. Interrupt: When Beneath the Petals is revealed from your deck, place it in shadows and gain 1 gold.

cards.name: Growing Influence
cards.text: Interrupt: When the effects of an opponent's triggered character or location ability would initiate, give that player 1 gold from your gold pool to cancel those effects.
cards.flavor: “The bride's father and brothers have bent the knee and sworn him their swords.”- Tywin Lannister

cards.name: Lysa Arryn
cards.text: Each House Arryn character you control is considered to be loyal. While your initiative value is 0, Lysa Arryn gains the keywords of each other loyal character you control.
cards.flavor: "The Lannisters are all liars. No one will hurt my sweet boy."

cards.name: Biter
cards.text: Intimidate. Reaction: After Biter kneels a character with a lower STR than his using intimidate, sacrifice him to kill that character.
cards.flavor: Half-healed burns covered his body, making him even more hideous than before.

cards.name: The Bastard of Driftmark
cards.text: Shadow (4). Stealth. Reaction: After a Warship location enters play under your control, stand The Bastard of Driftmark. (Limit twice per phase.)
cards.flavor: “I am told that removing the head from the body is often mortal.”

cards.name: Alleras the Sphinx
cards.text: Reaction: After you lose a challenge in which Alleras the Sphinx is participating, search the top 10 cards of your deck for a card, reveal it, and place it facedown under your agenda. Shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: He had only been at the Citadel for a year, yet already he had forged three links of his maester's chain.

cards.name: Elder Brother
cards.text: While you have a The Seven plot card revealed, Elder Brother cannot be killed.
cards.flavor: “He has restored many a man to health that even the Maesters could not cure, and many a woman too.” - Narbert

cards.name: Harrenhal Cupbearer
cards.text: Shadow (3). Reaction: After you win a challenge in which Harrenhal Cupbearer is participating, return it to shadows to choose and kneel a character with printed cost 5 or lower controlled by the losing opponent.

cards.name: Candle in the Dark
cards.text: Attached character cannot be bypassed by stealth. Interrupt: When the effects of a triggered card ability would initiate, if that card has shadow, kneel attached character to cancel those effects.

cards.name: The Warden of the East
cards.text: House Arryn character only. Attached character gets +2 STR and gains the Commander trait. Reaction: After 1 or more characters are revealed from an opponent's hand, deck, or shadows area, attached character gains 1 power. (Limit 3 times per round.)

cards.name: A Meeting of Minds
cards.text: Each Small Council character you control gains insight.
cards.flavor: “He entrusts some small matters to us, to lighten his load.” - Varys

cards.name: Ibbenese Whaler
cards.text: Shadow (2). Reduce the cost to marshal your first card into shadows each round by 1. Taxation Action: If you have no cards in your hand, kneel and return Ibbenese Whaler to shadows to draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Milkwater Crossing
cards.text: Reaction: After a phase begins, kneel and sacrifice Milkwater Crossing to have each character lose all keywords and immunities until the end of the phase. +1 Initiative.

cards.name: "Widow's Ford"
cards.text: Shadow (0). Reaction: After an attachment or location enters your discard pile, place it in shadows with a shadow token on it. While that card is in shadows, it gains shadow (X). X is its printed cost.

cards.name: Reinstatement
cards.text: Standing Action: Kneel your faction card to put a Small Council character into play from your discard pile.
cards.flavor: “Someone has to rule this damnable kingdom. Put on the badge, Ned. It suits you.”- Robert Baratheon

cards.name: Battle Beneath the Wall
cards.text: When Revealed: Name a challenge type. Until you reveal a new plot card, each player must declare all eligible characters as attackers or defenders during challenges of that type.

cards.name: City of Shadows
cards.text: When Revealed: Choose a card you control with shadow and return it to your hand. (You may return it to shadows instead if there is a City plot card in your used pile.)

cards.name: The Doom of Valyria
cards.text: When Revealed: If there are 3 or more plot cards in your used pile, discard each non-limited card from play, and each card in shadows. An opponent may discard their hand (of at least 3 cards) to cancel this effect.

cards.name: The War of the Five Kings
cards.text: Raise the claim value on The War of the Five Kings by 1 for each rival you have.

cards.name: The Minstrel's Muse
cards.text: You cannot play more than 3 events this round. Reaction: After a Song event is played, draw 1 card.

cards.name: The Age of Heroes
cards.text: Reaction: After the challenges phase begins, kneel your faction card to search your deck for a Legacy or Valyrian Steel attachment, reveal it, and add it to your hand (you may put it into play instead if it is a Tapestry attachment). Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Striking at Dawn
cards.text: Each character's STR cannot be increased or reduced by card effects.
cards.flavor: “We shall see, brother. Come the dawn, we shall see.” - Stannis Baratheon

cards.name: Strained Reserves
cards.text: Each player cannot marshal or put into play more than 2 characters, locations, or attachments this round. (4 characters, locations, or attachments instead if that player has a Summer plot card revealed.)

cards.name: Armed to the Teeth
cards.text: Your deck cannot include non-Weapon attachments. After all agendas are announced, search your deck for up to 5 different attachments, reveal them, and place them facedown under this agenda. Reaction: After you win a challenge, kneel your faction card and pay X gold to put an attachment with printed cost X into play from under this agenda.
cards.designer: Card design by 2022 Stahleck Joust World Champion, Marti Foz Hernandez.

cards.name: The Small Council
cards.text: You may include non-loyal Small Council characters from any faction in your deck. You must include at least 7 different Small Council characters in your deck. Reaction: After you win dominance, choose a standing Small Council character you control and have it gain 1 power. Then, if you control a King or Queen character, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Trading With Braavos
cards.text: Your deck may include non-loyal Warship locations from any faction. Your deck cannot include more than 1 copy of each non-limited location. Reaction: After claim is applied for a challenge you won, kneel your faction card to search the top 10 cards of your deck for a non-limited location, reveal it, and add it to your hand (you may place it in shadows instead if it has the Warship trait). Shuffle your deck.
